courses.title: Introduction to Programming
courses.description: Basic concepts of imperative programming. Data types, expressions, control flow, functions, arrays and pointers. Program decomposition, debugging and testing. Practical work in C.
learning_outcomes: Write, compile and debug small imperative programs
Decompose a problem into functions

courses.title: Data Structures and Algorithms
courses.description: Abstract data types and their implementations: lists, stacks, queues, trees, hash tables and graphs. Algorithm design techniques and asymptotic complexity analysis. Sorting and searching algorithms.
learning_outcomes: Choose an appropriate data structure for a problem
Analyse the asymptotic complexity of an algorithm

courses.title: Object-Oriented Programming
courses.description: Classes, objects, encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism. Interfaces and abstract classes, generics, exception handling, collections. Design principles and common design patterns. Practical work in Java.
learning_outcomes: Design a class hierarchy
Apply standard design patterns

courses.title: Databases 1
courses.description: The relational data model, relational algebra and SQL. Conceptual modelling with entity-relationship diagrams, functional dependencies and normalisation up to BCNF. Introduction to transactions and indexing.
learning_outcomes: Design a normalised relational schema
Write non-trivial SQL queries

courses.title: Operating Systems
courses.description: Processes and threads, scheduling, synchronisation and deadlock. Virtual memory and paging. File systems, input/output subsystems and device drivers. Practical work with system calls on Unix-like systems.
learning_outcomes: Explain how an operating system schedules and isolates processes
Write programs using system calls and threads

courses.title: Computer Networks
courses.description: Layered network architectures, the TCP/IP stack, addressing and routing. Reliable transport, congestion control, application protocols such as HTTP and DNS. Basics of network security. Socket programming.
learning_outcomes: Explain the function of each layer of the TCP/IP stack
Implement a simple client-server application over sockets

courses.title: Formal Languages and Automata
courses.description: Regular languages, finite automata and regular expressions. Context-free grammars and pushdown automata. The Chomsky hierarchy, Turing machines, decidability and the limits of computation. Applications to lexical analysis and parsing.
learning_outcomes: Construct automata and grammars for given languages
Argue about decidability of simple problems

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence
courses.description: Problem solving by search, heuristic search and adversarial search. Knowledge representation and logical inference. Introduction to machine learning: supervised learning, evaluation, and neural networks. Practical work in Python.
learning_outcomes: Implement informed search algorithms
Train and evaluate a simple classifier

courses.title: Software Engineering
courses.description: The software development lifecycle, requirements elicitation and specification, architectural and detailed design, version control, testing strategies, code review and agile process models. Team project work.
learning_outcomes: Elicit and document requirements
Work effectively in a version-controlled team project

courses.title: Web Programming
courses.description: Client-side technologies: HTML, CSS and JavaScript, the DOM and asynchronous requests. Server-side programming, REST APIs, templating, sessions and authentication. Deployment of a complete web application.
learning_outcomes: Build a client-server web application
Design and consume a REST API
